summary: Selects and clamps a tire compound setting. Reads the compound mode selector at this+0x1B34 (dword index 1741) and switches 1-4: each case writes a compound value (12/14/16/16) into this+0xD98 (index 870) and a compound index (0/1/2/3) into this+0x1170 (index 1116), clamping both against per-object min/max bounds (0xD98 to [0xDA0, 0xDA4], 0x1170 to [0x1178, 0x117C]). Returns mode-1; any mode outside 1-4 returns immediately with no state change.

local_names.result: mode selector minus one, returned on unhandled modes and after clamping
local_names.this[870]: tire compound value at offset 0xD98, set to 12/14/16 per mode
local_names.this[872]: compound value minimum bound at offset 0xDA0
local_names.this[873]: compound value maximum bound at offset 0xDA4
local_names.this[1116]: tire compound index at offset 0x1170, set to 0/1/2/3 per mode
local_names.this[1118]: compound index minimum bound at offset 0x1178
local_names.this[1119]: compound index maximum bound at offset 0x117C

operations.description: Compute result = this[1741] - 1 from the compound mode selector at this+0x1B34.
Switch on the compound mode selector at this+0x1B34 with cases 1-4; any other value hits the default and returns immediately with no field writes.
Case 1: write 12 to compound value this+0xD98, clamp it to [0xDA0, 0xDA4], and set compound index this+0x1170 to 0.
Case 2: write 14 to compound value this+0xD98, clamp it to [0xDA0, 0xDA4], and set compound index this+0x1170 to 1.
Case 3: write 16 to compound value this+0xD98, clamp it to [0xDA0, 0xDA4], and set compound index this+0x1170 to 2.
Case 4: write 16 to compound value this+0xD98, clamp it to [0xDA0, 0xDA4], and set compound index this+0x1170 to 3.
Shared tail (LABEL_22) for cases 1-4: clamp compound index this+0x1170 to the [0x1178, 0x117C] min/max bounds.
The switch dispatches through the jump table at 0x004AF384 (jpt_4AF231).
Invoked from sub_472510 and TrackEnvironmentSelect; returns the unmodified result on unhandled modes and after successful clamping.

unresolved: The meaning of the compound constants 12/14/16 and indexes 0-3 (tire compound presets) is structural; the caller at TrackEnvironmentSelect consumes them, but their semantic mapping is not confirmed here.
The min/max bounds at 0xDA0/0xDA4 and 0x1178/0x117C are per-object values written elsewhere; their source is not recoverable from this function alone.
